intro: A Missing Hand is a quest in Durotar concerning the sudden disappearance of Heglan Shadeeye, a Shattered Hand scout tasked with keeping watch on Tiragarde Keep. When her regular intelligence dispatches abruptly cease, an investigator is sent to find her post and uncover what silenced her.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... Subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.
I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.
Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
